description: Insurance sales record check under the Korean Financial Consumer Protection Act: suitability items (제17조), material explanations (제19조, incl. replacement comparison when switching), how the explanation document was delivered and how understanding was confirmed (signature, seal or recording). Returns missing items, the cooling-off outer date (청약일 + 30 days, 제46조), the 10-year retention date (제28조) and a copy-ready Korean record text. Not an official compliance determination.
